text:
alex_sales: FYI — Jordan (Acme) wants to kick off the POC next week. Need to align on what sample data they can share, how we'll handle redaction, and connectivity (S3 presign vs VPC). Jordan, can you confirm constraints and timeline?

jordan_cust: We cannot share PHI or raw customer IDs. Can provide ~10k anonymized chat logs + 50 sample docs. Timeline: 3 weeks to complete POC. Prefer the fastest path — presigned S3 upload — but we can do VPC peering if needed.

maria_se: Quick notes — fastest path = encrypted S3 with presigned PUTs, TTL 1h. Alternative is temporary VPC peering + a dedicated sandbox (private deployment) if you need network isolation. For evals we'll need a labelled set (~500) for intent/precision checks.

devops_eng: For S3 flow we can create a temp bucket and provide presigned URLs. We can also accept an IAM role for direct pulls. Example presign CLI: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc-ingest/sample.json --expires-in 3600
```
If you want the more secure route, we can request VPC CIDR and provision peering. Which do you prefer?

lina_security: Important — if logs contain PII/PHI we require deterministic redaction before upload. Options: customer-side redaction (preferred) OR we run redaction on our side under a documented process (needs signed approval). We need a completed security questionnaire before we ingest. We are SOC2 compliant; retention for sandbox artifacts is 30 days unless you request otherwise.

alex_sales: Proposed success criteria (draft):
1) Latency: p95 < 300ms for 512-token responses under test load
2) Accuracy: >= 85% F1 on labelled intent extraction / entity extraction evals
3) Hallucination: < 5% critical hallucinations on a 200-sample set
4) Cost: estimated <= $Y per 1k queries (we'll refine after we see token distribution)
5) Data handling: no sensitive tokens returned in outputs; redaction verification passed by security team
Does that align with Acme's goals?

maria_se: Aligning on concrete evals — we'll run categories: summarization, entity extraction, intent classification, rerank. Example prompts: 
- "Summarize customer issue in 2 sentences"
- "Extract product ids and invoice numbers"
- "Classify intent: billing/support/feature"
We recommend a labelled eval set of 500 examples and an unlabeled set of ~5k for throughput/cost testing. I can share the eval harness and metrics dashboard after we get samples.

jordan_cust: We can provide 500 labelled for intent + 1k unlabeled logs. For redaction we'll replace emails with <EMAIL>, names with <NAME>. Is that sufficient?

lina_security: That helps. Please also hash account numbers and replace any payment PANs with <REDACTED_PAN>. Provide a redaction mapping doc (what placeholders map to what original fields). Also confirm that the sanitized artifacts will not contain free-form PII in the text.

devops_eng: Network options recap:
- Presigned S3: fastest, minimal infra work. We provide presigned PUTs and a short TTL ingestion job.
- IAM role + cross-account pull: secure, needs org approval.
- VPC peering: most isolated, needs CIDR & L3 contact, longer lead time (~3 business days).
If you want us to simulate production latency, we can also spin up a dedicated sandbox cluster (extra cost).

alex_sales: Pricing note for the deal team — hosted sandbox: first week complimentary, then pay-as-you-go. Dedicated sandbox for traffic simulation: rough estimate $X/day for the configuration that supports ~2k qps. I'll get a formal quote after we see sample token sizes.

maria_se: I'll prepare the eval plan and a deck of ~20 canonical prompts. Quick eval harness snippet (example curl to our hosted API):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large-v1","input":"Summarize customer issue in 2 sentences","max_tokens":120}'
```
We batch these and compute precision/recall/hallucination rates.

jordan_cust: I'll run redaction on our side and share a sample bundle by 2026-04-01. I'll also loop in our network lead (CIDR + contact) in case we decide to peer.

lina_security: I'll DM the security questionnaire and the redaction checklist EOD. Once we have the sanitized sample, we'll run a redaction verification pass and provide a short report.

devops_eng: When Jordan uploads samples we'll provision the temp bucket and the ingest job. Demo sandbox id reserved: sbx-0923.

demo_env_bot: Sandbox instance created (id: sbx-0923) — awaiting data upload.

alex_sales: Next steps (action items):
- Jordan: approve data handling plan + upload sanitized samples by 2026-04-01 :calendar:
- Lina: send security questionnaire + redaction checklist by EOD :email:
- Devops: prepare presigned bucket and ingestion job once samples arrive
- Maria: share eval harness, prompt deck, and baseline metrics within 2 business days after sample receipt
- Alex: send POC quote for dedicated sandbox if requested
Any objections or additions? :thumbsup:

jordan_cust: All good from my side. I'll ping once the first bundle is uploaded.

alex_sales: Great — thanks everyone. I'll track tasks in the deal plan and follow up tomorrow. :rocket:
